en-US.longDescription: The Ham Intelligent Calculator, also called Hamic, is a program designed to simplify a number of calculations commonly used by Hams. It is designed for the Ham radio hobbyist, but may be useful to others as well. Hamic has a simple to use, but powerful graphical interface that allows solving simple circuits such as resistors in series or parallel, or more complex circuits such as L networks or T networks. As well, other calculations such as SWR, reactance, resonant frequency, inductance of an air core coil, and antenna impedance are supported. One of the more powerful features of Hamic is to solve for almost any unknown variable in a circuit; Hamic can even solve L networks without having to use Smith charts. Also, Hamic can easily convert between a number of different units. Once you have finished your work, your calculations can be saved to a worksheet and retrieved later. People interested in working with circuits or antennas should check this program out!
en-US.name: Hamic

zh-CN.description: 无线电爱好者的智能计算器
zh-CN.longDescription: Hamic 是一款无线电爱好者的智能计算器程序，旨在简化无线电爱好者常用的一些计算。它是为业余无线电爱好者设计的，但对其他人也可能有用。Hamic 有一个简单但强大的图形界面，可以求解简单的电路，例如电阻串联或并联，或者更复杂的电路，例如 L 形网络或 T 形网络。此外，程序还支持计算驻波比、电抗、谐振频率、空芯线圈电感和天线阻抗等。Hamic 更强大的功能之一是解决电路中几乎所有的未知变量；Hamic 甚至可以求解 L 形网络，而不必使用 Smith 图表。Hamic 还可以轻松地在多种单位之间进行换算。在完成工作后，你可以将你的计算结果保存至工作表中，以供日后检索。对电路或天线感兴趣的人应该看看这个程序！
zh-CN.name: Hamic
